tldr: DeepSeek open-sourced its Harness agentic coding tool alongside the V4 Pro release on Aug 13, positioning it as a free rival to Claude Code and Claude Cowork. An Aug 24 analysis then argued Harness's plugin architecture, not the V4 Pro model itself, was the more consequential shift.
whats_new: The thread's newest linked item, published Sept 2, is Google Cloud's own unrelated 'Mantis' bug-finding harness — not a DeepSeek development, despite sharing the 'harness' label.
why_it_matters: If you're tracking open-source coding harnesses, DeepSeek's Harness (agentic coding) and Google's Mantis (vulnerability discovery) are unrelated products that only share a name — don't conflate their capabilities or roadmaps.
